doc.title: Control Sequence API Tech Spec
doc.snippet: GET /api/v1/health returns status:healthy and active_instances count. NFR4 requires less than 10ms p95 response time.

doc.title: Story 1.11 G36 Controller
doc.snippet: Router pattern uses FastAPI Depends for DI. Use app.include_router() for registration. FmuAdapter.get_instance() for singleton access.

constraints.constraint: Follow MVC pattern: Router (HTTP) → Controller (Business Logic) → Adapter (FMU)
Use FastAPI Depends() for dependency injection
Use Pydantic models for request/response DTOs
TDD: Write tests first, then implement
No mocking of FmuAdapter in integration tests - test with real singleton
Health endpoint must respond in less than 10ms (NFR4)
API path prefix: /api/v1/ for versioned endpoints
FmuAdapter is singleton - use get_instance() not constructor

interface.name: HealthResponse
interface.signature: HealthResponse(status: str, active_instances: int, service: str, version: str)

tests.standards: TDD approach: write failing tests first, implement to make them pass. Use pytest with pytest-asyncio for async tests. Unit tests mock external dependencies. Integration tests use real FmuAdapter singleton with reset between tests. Test files follow pattern test_*.py in tests/unit/ or tests/integration/ directories.

Test response time is less than 10ms using time measurement
Test /api/v1/health appears in OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json
